Darren ar i pengaknipa och Jimmy jagar svunna tiders framgångar på tennisbanorna och darfor återforenas de for ett minst sagt optimistiskt forsok att kvala in till en Grand Slam-turnering. Båda har sett sina basta dagar, men med hjalp av några okonventionella vanner och en uppmuntrande, men cynisk pappa full av mordande kommentarer kanske de två medelmåttorna kan hitta tillbaka till det som kravs for att vinna over eliten.Med komikerna Jeremy Sisto, Adam Devine och den Oscar® vinnande skådespelaren J.K.

programme.title: Wagons East
programme.desc: De kom for guld, men nu nojer de sig med rinnande vatten. John Candy och Richard Lewis spelar huvudrollerna i denna dråpligt okonventionella blick på den legendariska vastvarlden.

programme.title: 36 Husbands
programme.desc: 36 Husbands ar en mystisk, musikalisk, Kung Fu-spionkomedi med tre maktiga kvinnor – och ett gang akta man. Toppspionen och Kung Fu-mastaren Krista har speciella krafter och hon anvander dem for att få marschen mot ett tredje varldskrig att gå långsammare.

programme.title: The Birdcage - Lånta Fjadrar
programme.desc: I denna hysteriska komedi har Armand och Albert byggt det perfekta livet for sig sjalva genom att skota sin nattklubb i Miami. Men deras pastellfargade lugn skakas nar Armands son meddelar att han ska gifta sig med dottern till den ultrakonservativa senatorn Keeley... och de ska alla samlas till middag! Kan Armand och Albert forvandla sig till Herr och Fru Familjevarderingar i tid?

programme.title: The Stag
programme.desc: En valdigt modern blivande brudgum sager motvilligt ja till en svensexa med sina urbana kompisar i vastra Irlands vildmarker. Till gangets fasa får de sallskap av brudens oberaknelige bror, en alfahanne som kallas "Maskinen" och vars explosiva personlighet och vilda ledarskap tar med dem på en resa som de aldrig glommer.

programme.title: Mitt namn ar Nobody
programme.desc: Nobody (Terence Hill) ar en revolverhjalte som ar lika snabb på avtryckaren som han ar rapp i kaften! Hans kompanjon ar Beauregard (Henry Fonda), en arrad gammal gunfighter på jakt efter sin brors mordare. Tillsammans levererar de lika många kulharvar som skrattsalvor och stalls mot 150 vilda revolverman – samtidigt!

programme.title: Shriek If You Know What I Did Last Friday the 13th
programme.desc: En reporter undersoker en serie mord som kallas Spring Break-massakern, vilket leder till fler illdåd i denna slasherfilmparodi.

programme.title: Happy-Go-Lucky
programme.desc: Lararen Poppy anvander sin andlosa optimism for att ta sig genom livets små draman och sprider skratt och gladje till de som finns i narheten.

programme.title: Dina, mina och våra (Yours, Mine and Ours)
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid och Rene Russo spelar huvudrollerna i denna harliga nyinspelning av filmen från 1968 med samma namn. En ankeman som ar kustbevakningsamiral och en anka som ar handvaskedesigner blir kara och gifter sig, till stor fortret for hennes 10 och hans 8 barn. Nar barnen planerar att skilja sina foraldrar inser de att det viktigaste ar familjen.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Forfattaren Richard Dunne (JEFF BRIDGES) har en låtsaskompis som foljt honom sedan barnsben: superhjalten Captain Excellent (RYAN REYNOLDS). I ett forsok att återvinna sin forna storhet som forfattare, skickas han ivag till Cape Cod av sin fru Claire (LISA KUDROW) for att skriva sin andra roman. Men då Captain Excellent foljer med som kumpan och hejarklack blir livet dar inte riktigt som planerat... Den 17-åriga flickan Abby (EMMA STONE), vars tragiska forflutna har lett henne till att fly in i sina fantasier, ansluter sig till sallskapet, och en mycket speciell vanskap uppstår.

programme.title: The Details
programme.desc: Jeff (Tobey Maguire) och Nealy (Elizabeth Banks) bor i en idyllisk forort och har varit lyckligt gifta i 10 år. Men nar en familj av tvattbjornar invaderar deras perfekta tradgård blir Jeff besatt av att utrota djuren med alla mojliga medel. Kampen mot skadesdjuren startar en flirt med den vackra grannen Lila (Laura Linney), och innan han vet ordet av har han inlett en absurd spiral av otrohet, utpressning och organdonation.

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: Det har gått mer an 10 år sedan vårt senaste besok på Calvins Barbershop. Calvin och hans trogna team ar fortfarande dar, men butiken har genomgått stora forandringar. Mest markbart ar att vår tidigare mansdominerade fristad nu ar konsblandad.

programme.title: Dom kallar mej Trinity - Djavulens hogra hand
programme.desc: Denna vildsinta parodi på ""7 vågade livet"" gjorde Spencer/Hill till stjarnor! Han har en kaft lika valoljad som hans revolver. Han har ett rykte lika smutsigt som kladerna han rider i. Han sager att han ar en fredens man - men vem vågar tro honom? Hans namn ar Trinity - Djavulens hogra hand. I stan traffar Trinity sin ohangde bror Bambino och de kommer i bråk med den skurkaktige Majoren som forsoker ta over stan. Men Trinity och Bambino moter hotet med det enda språk som bovar forstår kulor och storsmockor!

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: I denna skandalosa parodi på Paranormal Activity-filmerna hemsoks ett ungt par som precis flyttat in i sitt dromhem. Kort efter inflyttning upptacker de att de inte langre ar ensamma. Men det ar inte huset som ar hemsokt, det ar Malcolms flickvan. Malcolm hyr in allt från praster till Ghostbusters så att denna demon inte ska få forstora hans forhållande ... eller, annu viktigare, hans sexliv.

programme.title: Three Day Millionaire
programme.desc: En skranig komedi om ett gang unga fiskare från Grimsbys regndrankta hamn i norra England, som måste genomfora sitt livs kupp for att radda staden. Glom Oceans 11, och gor er redo for Grimsbys 4.

programme.title: Balls Out: Gary the Tennis Coach
programme.desc: En overentusiastisk vaktmastare på en high-school I USA ger sig på att trana ett gang missanpassade ungdomar for att vinna Nebraska state tennis championship.

programme.title: The Beach Bum
programme.desc: I The Beach Bum får vi folja Moondogs (Matthew McConaughey) skandallosa missoden. En rebellisk och utbrand man som lever livet efter sina egna regler. I rollistan ser vi stjarnor som Snoop Dogg, Isla Fisher, Zac Efron, Jimmy Buffet, Martin Lawrence och Jonah Hill. The Beach Bum ar en ny, originell och revolutionerande komedi av manusforfattaren och regissoren Harmony Korine.

programme.title: Låt de doda vila
programme.desc: Jimmy ar inte bara en fan av heavy metal, skrack, och det ockulta. Han har ett mål: han vill kontakta sin avlidna mamma. Den nya killen i klassen, charmoren Amir, lockar Jimmy till att imponera skolans två snyggaste tjejer, Louise och Anna, med en liten rit. Efter riten inser Jimmy, att han har begått ett forfardligt misstag, som kan grava fram doda hemligheter och betyda hela jordens undergång.

programme.title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
programme.desc: I denna hysteriskt fracka komedi blir de dysfunktionella amerikanska syskonen Alice och Paul – tillsammans med deras alltid optimistiska mamma – inbjudna till det brittiska brollopet for deras avlagsna halvsyster, Eloise, som en chans att återknyta som – mer eller mindre – vuxna och lara sig att alska varandra som forr.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: På Westerburg High dar klicken harskar, jocks dominerar och alla populara tjejer heter Heather, kommer det att kravas en Veronica och ett mystiskt nytt barn for att ge tonårsångest en kroppsrakning.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than hed ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. Hes assigned to escort an emirs daughter to her fathers mountain citadel and learn about the emirs activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Cheyenne Rides Again
programme.desc: Get ready for thundering thrills! A lawman (Tom Tyler) pretends to be an outlaw, steals $10,000 from a cattle thief, then promises to return the money if he can join the gang. Meanwhile, his real mission is to expose the bad guys! Lon Chaney Jr stars appears in one of his early roles for director Robert F. Hill (Shadow of Chinatown; Flash Gordon).

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila OConner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Arizona Thunderbolt
programme.desc: When Sue Bixby becomes his new boss, stagecoach robber Talbot reforms and goes after her rustled cattle. When he and his men are outnumbered fighting Lloyds gang, Randall rides to get circus man Mahoney and his man shooting cannon.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Raiders of the Border
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Nevada Jack McKenzie (Johnny Mack Brown) and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) go undercover to catch jewelry smugglers in this vintage western from Monogram Pictures. This was one of the last films directed by John P. McCarthy (Song of the Gringo, The Oklahoma Cyclone), while Johnny Mack Brown would go on to find great success as Nevada Jack; this was the fourth of 19 films where he played the crime busting marshal.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are ordered to San Pablo, Mexico, to find out whats behind the trouble an American tungsten mine is having. When they arrive, they discover the mine has been closed, the wells are all poisoned and the town is in the grip of a malaria epidemic. To make matters worse, the lawmen have been followed by four gunslingers determined to give the American troubleshooters all the trouble they can handle - and more. Russell Hayden stars.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, Pat and Stoney tangle with a gang of robbers who have hijacked an Army payroll. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. Originally aired on NBC.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 My Daughter the Doctor
programme.desc: The family wants Billie Jo to become a doctor, but she wants to go to Hollywood to become an actress. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. And be sure to look for Adam West in a pre-Batman role as Doctor Clayton Harris. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in January, 1964.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Billie Jo recieves an endowment, but instead of using it for medical school, she wishes to go to Hollywood.Kate meets with Judge Drucker to see if she can legally prevent the girl from goinng. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho are falsely accused of robbing a stagecoach. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Two bandits impersonate Cisco and Pancho, sending the two to prison for robbery and murder. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was nominated for a PrimeTime Emmy Award in 1951. It was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie face off with a murdering desperado who has been terrorizing the northwest. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also starring Steve Brodie, RIchard Avonde, Helen Wallace, Gene Roth, and Edward Clark. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954 .Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Wild Bunch of Wyoming
programme.desc: Matt and Frankie meet the Wild Bunch and their jovial leader Butch Cassidy.Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also starring Joe Sawyer, Slim Pickens, Lane Chandler, and Bob Carney. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In Family Ties, Judge Bean comes to the aid of the Peralta family as unscrupulous real estate agents try to force them off their land. Theyve learned that a railroad will need the property and they intend to make an undeserved profit. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, crooks posing as newspapermen attempt to blackmail a local rancher in order to steal his land and property. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: An ex-convict is trying to work as a rancher, but his outlaw brother wants him to resume his life of crime. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie and Lofty attempt to help Ralph and Mary claim a fertile piece of land after a section of land is opened for settlement. A pair of crooks are aware of the lands value and intend to take it for themselves. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which earned a Primetime Emmy Award nomination in 1955.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook suspect that a young mans uncle is behind the recent attacks against him. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper.Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: A man asserts that he has a Royal Grant that gives him ownership of the entire town.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in November, 1957.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After the Virginia City bank is robbed by an outlaw gang, the gangs youngest member gets a job on the Ponderosa. Initially welcomed, Little Joe becomes suspicious of Ponderosas newest member.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Leather Burners
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) gets the call when a herd of rustled cattle mysteriously disappear. Andy Clyde, Victor Jory and George Reeves (televisions Superman!) also star in this, the 42nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy features. If you look closely, you might even notice Robert Mitchum in an uncredited role!

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomezs camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Painted Desert
programme.desc: A mightly melodrama of red-blooded action, William Boyd stars in the Pre-Code western talkie - The Painted Desert (1931). The first sound film for Hollywood heavyweight Clark Gable, The Painted Desert finds Boyd and Gable at odds over the affections of a cowboys beautiful daughter (Helen Twelvetrees).

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, hes falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Brand of the Devil
programme.desc: The Texas Rangers tangle with a band of dangerous rustlers in this two-fisted production from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Starring Dave OBrien, Kermit Maynard, and Guy Wilkerson, with direction by low-budget ace Harry L. Fraser.

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the...

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In an episode called Koniakers, G-Men Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett investigate how U.S. currency in a bank vault was replaced by counterfeit money. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

Episode originally aired in December, 1957.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After a U.S. deputy marshal saves Adams life from two gunmen, he explains that he is in town to bring a close friend of the Cartwrights to San Francisco to testify in a statewide racketeering trial, but the Deputy Marshals motives for the witness soon become suspicious.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort. From 1960.

programme.title: Prairie Pals
programme.desc: ITS A MODERN GOLD RUSH GANGSTER STYLE! But Three Ridin Singin Fightin Buckaroos Stop Em Cold! The Prairie Pals are on the lookout for Wainwright, a scientist who has gone missing after discovering a way to turn vanadium ore into gold. The Prairie Pals start their search at Hank Stoners land, where the vanadium ore can be found. Directed by Sam Newfield; starring Bill Cowboy Rambler Boyd, Art Davis, and Lee Powell.

programme.title: Cowboy and the Senorita
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger get top billing in this one, while the senorita of the title, Dale Evans, is billed fourth. Maybe Dale needed a better agent! Then again, who pays attention to screen credits when you have such a funfilled fiesta of thrills and action? Roys most zestful musical adventure is about a worthless gold mine that turns out to have a hidden shaft filled with riches. But can Roy make the claim while hes trying to outrun a trumped up robbery charge? Its romance, rhythm, and revelry, all from Republic Pictures. Musical numbers include Bunk House Bugle Boy and Besame Mucho, plus the beautiful title song performed by Roy!

programme.title: Heart of the Golden West
programme.desc: Roy Rogers, Gabby Hayes, and Smiley Burnette team up to protect the ranchers of Cherokee City from the false charges of illegal cattle trafficking. It may seem like the odds are against Roy, but just watch as he changes the course of the law with his flaming bullets, and, of course, a few songs. For trivia buffs: Smiley Burnette joined Roy because Gene Autry, the actor for whom he usually served as a sidekick, had joined the service!

programme.title: Tumbleweeds
programme.desc: The great William S. Hart stars in this classic tale of settlers in the Oklahoma territory. Directed by King Baggot, one of the most versatile movie figures of the silent era, this movie is not only history recorded in heart throbs, as the original print ads boasted, but shows us why Hart is considered by some to be the top western actor of them all. Hart, who directed many of his own films, also had a hand in directing this feature, which turned out to be his last starring role.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: Brother battles brother in this gritty tale of feuding ranchers in the old west. This story of the Texas panhandle stars such familiar faces as Robert Preston, Chill Wills, and Jack Elam, and was a rare film for its time in that it was filmed almost entirely in Texas with no studio interiors. If for no other reason, watch this one for Prestons performance. If you only know him from The Music Man or Victor Victoria, youre sure to be surprised here! (also, look for John Drew Barrymore as Jef Cloud. He was part of the famous Barrymore family, and father of Drew Barrymore.) Jim Strake: Frank Cordell. The Whip: Dave Kashner. Directed by George Templeton

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes epic 1943 western, but the character youll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Regrets, Family and Ducati: A Deep-Dive with MotoGPs Marc Marquez
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Uri Puigdemont sits down with eight-time World Champion and newest Ducati MotoGP rider, Marc Marquez. In it, Marc talks about his career-defining switch from Honda to Ducati in 2023, the relationship between himself and brother Alex as they both compete for the sport’s greatest prize, how his family are dealing with the fights on-track, and how he’s getting along with new teammate Francesco Bagnaia. There’s also a deep-dive into Marquez’s mentality, from the recent chaos of that aborted start in Austin, the crash that ended his perfect start to 2025, and what Marc would tell his 18 year old self, nearly 15 years after his first World Championship in the 125cc...

programme.title: How chaos ultimately decided the final podium lineup - F1 British GP Review
programme.desc: The British Grand Prix didn’t disappoint, with a dream victory for Lando Norris, beating teammate Oscar Piastri after the Australian picked up a 10-second penalty for erratic driving behind the Safety Car. But the star of the show was Sauber’s Nico Hulkenberg, who after 15 years and 239 starts in Formula 1, finally got his first podium finish. Autosport Editor-In-Chief Kevin Turner sits down with Jake Boxall-Legge and Ronald Vording to discuss all the action and news from Silverstone. Including Hulks "incredible" podium, whether Piastri should have been penalised, Max Verstappens spin from second and the persistent rumours over his future, and Mohammed Ben Sulayems challenger for...

programme.title: Episode 6: Hellas Rally Raid and Monster Jam
programme.desc: Gearing Up is back with another thrilling episode that takes you on an exhilarating journey around the globe, showcasing the most unique and intense competitions the world has to offer. In this episode, high skills, a passion for technology, an impatience for innovation, and a pure love for adrenaline are combined at their best. Buckle up, rev your engines, and get ready for some electrifying action as you experience the thrill of full G-force! The episode kicks off with Hellas Rally Raid. The Hellas Rally Raid is an international off-road motorsports event held annually in the landscapes of Greece. Spanning 7 days, it challenges riders and drivers to navigate through hundreds of...

programme.title: From Wheelchair to Race Car - How Robert Wickens Overcame the Odds
programme.desc: In 2018, a horrific crash at Pocono nearly ended Robert Wickens’ life—and seemingly ended his racing career. He suffered a double spinal cord fracture, multiple broken bones, and a severe pulmonary contusion. By the end of that year, Robert revealed he was a paraplegic. But Robert Wickens is not like most people. This is the story of a man who refused to be defined by the crash that changed everything. Through unwavering determination, incredible resilience, and the cutting-edge technology of Bosch Motorsport, Robert set his sights on an unthinkable goal: to race again at the highest level. This isn’t just a story about recovery—its about rediscovery. About holding onto your...

programme.title: What Horners sacking really means for Verstappen, F1 and Red Bull
programme.desc: After 20 years of service as Team Principal of Red Bull Racing, Christian Horner has been sacked by the team with immediate effect, with Laurent Meikes replacing Horner as Red Bull CEO, and Alan Permane taking Meikes’ job as Racing Bulls Team Principal. James Allen is joined in the studio to analyse the news with our correspondents Ronald Vording, Christian Nimmervoll and Ben Hunt to analyse what led to Horner’s sacking, what role Max Verstappen and his camp may have played in the decision, and what it means for Red Bull, Racing Bulls, and maybe even Ferrari in the future…

programme.title: Road to 2026, Episode 1: The Journey So Far
programme.desc: Before looking to the future and 2026s regulation changes, first we must look back at the past. In episode one of our new Road to 2026 series with ‪PETRONAS Motorsports‬ we look at the history of the partnership, the origin of hybrid technology in F1, and how, together, weve pushed the boundaries of innovation.

programme.title: Le Mans Classic 2025
programme.desc: Step back in time at Le Mans Classic, where we meet legendary race drivers and passionate car collectors to explore the enduring legacy of vintage machines. From the roaring icons of 1923 to the sleek speedsters of the ’90s, experience the full spectrum of historic racing — on and off the track.

programme.title: 2 + 4 = 24 documentary
programme.desc: 1 Rider. 1 Driver. 2 Races - each over 24 hours. 24 hours are always tough, no matter where you do it. Australian bike rider Josh Hook on Honda Fireblade and Portuguese racing driver Tiago Monteiro on Honda Civic Type R walk us through the challenging endurance races in detail and answer the question: what is it like to be a 2-wheel and 4-wheel race gladiator? Follow Josh Hook and Tiago Monteiro to the edges of hell and back in the two toughest 24 Hour races of 2020: 24 Hours of Nurburgring and 24 Heures Motos at Le Mans.

programme.title: Motorsport Images: An Enduring Legacy
programme.desc: 26 million images. 100 years of racing. This is the story of Motorsport Images, the premiere photographic agency and archive covering motorsport and motoring. It is unique in that it provides photography of all major current motorsport events, from Formula One Grand Prix racing to national level racing, as well as archive images documenting the history of the sport dating back to 1895.

programme.title: Fusion, Motorsport meets Sim Racing

programme.title: Episode 3: The future for adventure bikes
programme.desc: In this episode Graham takes a look at what the future holds for Adventure Bike, and what advantages electric engines can offer. programme.title: 2024-2025 ALMS: Round 4 - 4 Hours of Dubai

programme.title: George Drives the 1955 British Grand Prix Winning Mercedes F1 Car
programme.desc: Seventy years on from Sir Stirling Moss becoming the first Englishman to win the British Grand Prix, we honoured the famous legacy by bringing the Mercedes W196 back to Aintree for the first time since 1955. George Russell came with us - and he definitely enjoyed his time behind the wheel!

programme.title: Feels like yesterday - Álex Crivillé looks back on his legendary career

From his biggest rivals, to bike evolutions and his current favourite equestrian hobbies. Criville tells us all about it here at Motorsport.

programme.title: What it Takes to be an F1 World Champion - Exclusive Interview with Damon Hill
programme.desc: Joining James Allen on the podcast this week is Damon Hill, 1996 F1 World Champion and broadcaster, whilst he trains for his Neuro UK Fundraiser, cycling the 2024 LEtape du Tour event in France. The pair discuss everything from the upcoming 2024 Silverstone Grand Prix, what its like for British drivers to win their home race, engaging with F1s fanbase and what it takes to become an F1 World Champion. programme.desc: Watch race 2 of the third round of the 2025 Porsche Carrera Cup Brasil season at Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace.

programme.title: Regrets, Family and Ducati: A Deep-Dive with MotoGPs Marc Marquez
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Uri Puigdemont sits down with eight-time World Champion and newest Ducati MotoGP rider, Marc Marquez. In it, Marc talks about his career-defining switch from Honda to Ducati in 2023, the relationship between himself and brother Alex as they both compete for the sport’s greatest prize, how his family are dealing with the fights on-track, and how he’s getting along with new teammate Francesco Bagnaia. There’s also a deep-dive into Marquez’s mentality, from the recent chaos of that aborted start in Austin, the crash that ended his perfect start to 2025, and what Marc would tell his 18 year old self, nearly 15 years after his first World Championship in the 125cc...

programme.title: MLMC 2025: Round 1 - Barcelona Highlights
programme.desc: Catch all the highlights from the first round of the Michelin Le Mans Cup at Barcelona.

programme.title: How chaos ultimately decided the final podium lineup - F1 British GP Review
programme.desc: The British Grand Prix didn’t disappoint, with a dream victory for Lando Norris, beating teammate Oscar Piastri after the Australian picked up a 10-second penalty for erratic driving behind the Safety Car. But the star of the show was Sauber’s Nico Hulkenberg, who after 15 years and 239 starts in Formula 1, finally got his first podium finish. Autosport Editor-In-Chief Kevin Turner sits down with Jake Boxall-Legge and Ronald Vording to discuss all the action and news from Silverstone. Including Hulks "incredible" podium, whether Piastri should have been penalised, Max Verstappens spin from second and the persistent rumours over his future, and Mohammed Ben Sulayems challenger for...

programme.title: Episode 6: Hellas Rally Raid and Monster Jam
programme.desc: Gearing Up is back with another thrilling episode that takes you on an exhilarating journey around the globe, showcasing the most unique and intense competitions the world has to offer. In this episode, high skills, a passion for technology, an impatience for innovation, and a pure love for adrenaline are combined at their best. Buckle up, rev your engines, and get ready for some electrifying action as you experience the thrill of full G-force! The episode kicks off with Hellas Rally Raid. The Hellas Rally Raid is an international off-road motorsports event held annually in the landscapes of Greece. Spanning 7 days, it challenges riders and drivers to navigate through hundreds of...

programme.desc: Watch race 1 of the fourth round of the 2025 TCR South America season at Termas de Río Hondo, Argentina.

programme.title: From Wheelchair to Race Car - How Robert Wickens Overcame the Odds
programme.desc: In 2018, a horrific crash at Pocono nearly ended Robert Wickens’ life—and seemingly ended his racing career. He suffered a double spinal cord fracture, multiple broken bones, and a severe pulmonary contusion. By the end of that year, Robert revealed he was a paraplegic. But Robert Wickens is not like most people. This is the story of a man who refused to be defined by the crash that changed everything. Through unwavering determination, incredible resilience, and the cutting-edge technology of Bosch Motorsport, Robert set his sights on an unthinkable goal: to race again at the highest level. This isn’t just a story about recovery—its about rediscovery. About holding onto your...

programme.title: What Horners sacking really means for Verstappen, F1 and Red Bull
programme.desc: After 20 years of service as Team Principal of Red Bull Racing, Christian Horner has been sacked by the team with immediate effect, with Laurent Meikes replacing Horner as Red Bull CEO, and Alan Permane taking Meikes’ job as Racing Bulls Team Principal. James Allen is joined in the studio to analyse the news with our correspondents Ronald Vording, Christian Nimmervoll and Ben Hunt to analyse what led to Horner’s sacking, what role Max Verstappen and his camp may have played in the decision, and what it means for Red Bull, Racing Bulls, and maybe even Ferrari in the future…

programme.title: Road to 2026, Episode 1: The Journey So Far
programme.desc: Before looking to the future and 2026s regulation changes, first we must look back at the past. In episode one of our new Road to 2026 series with ‪PETRONAS Motorsports‬ we look at the history of the partnership, the origin of hybrid technology in F1, and how, together, weve pushed the boundaries of innovation.

programme.title: Le Mans Classic 2025
programme.desc: Step back in time at Le Mans Classic, where we meet legendary race drivers and passionate car collectors to explore the enduring legacy of vintage machines. From the roaring icons of 1923 to the sleek speedsters of the ’90s, experience the full spectrum of historic racing — on and off the track.

programme.title: 2 + 4 = 24 documentary
programme.desc: 1 Rider. 1 Driver. 2 Races - each over 24 hours. 24 hours are always tough, no matter where you do it. Australian bike rider Josh Hook on Honda Fireblade and Portuguese racing driver Tiago Monteiro on Honda Civic Type R walk us through the challenging endurance races in detail and answer the question: what is it like to be a 2-wheel and 4-wheel race gladiator? Follow Josh Hook and Tiago Monteiro to the edges of hell and back in the two toughest 24 Hour races of 2020: 24 Hours of Nurburgring and 24 Heures Motos at Le Mans.

programme.title: Motorsport Images: An Enduring Legacy
programme.desc: 26 million images. 100 years of racing. This is the story of Motorsport Images, the premiere photographic agency and archive covering motorsport and motoring. It is unique in that it provides photography of all major current motorsport events, from Formula One Grand Prix racing to national level racing, as well as archive images documenting the history of the sport dating back to 1895.

programme.title: 30:e november
programme.desc: Adam och hans polare spenderar sin tid med att trakassera invandrare som de hatar. Men så moter Adam Julia från Peru och de blir blixtforalskad, eftersom varken Adams vanner eller Julias familj skulle acceptera att de två ar tillsammans tvingas de hålla sin karlek hemlig. På Sveriges nationaldag drabbas Adam och hans gang samman med Julias bror, Sascha, och hans vanner. Det hela slutar med att två dodads.

programme.title: Layers of Lies
programme.desc: Nar han återvander till Iran efter många år i exil i Finland, finner Sam (Ramin Sohrab) att han annu inte har flytt från sitt forflutna. En skum figur kidnappar hans fru Emma (Jessica Wolff) for att dra in honom i ett våldsamt plan for hamnd. Men Sam ar en obeveklig kampmaskin som inte kommer att stoppa någonting for att radda kvinnan han alskar. Nar det galler att bestamma sin framtid kommer det forflutna inte att stå i vagen for dem... Layer of Lies ar en adrenalinfylld spanningstur genom den livliga, mångsidiga metropolen Teheran.

programme.title: Nicks Film
programme.desc: Lightning Over Water ar en rorande film om den amerikanske kultregissoren Nicholas Rays sista dagar. Ray var mest kand for filmen “Rebel Without a Cause”.Jag visste att han onskade att arbeta, och do medan han arbetade”, sager Wim Wenders i filmen. Och genom sitt arbete med Wenders och ovriga medarbetare, forvandlade Ray sin dod till ett samarbetsprojekt och ett konstverk. Han reflekterar over sitt livs prestationer, misslyckanden och kompromisser. Han berattar minnen om Joan Crawford, James Dean och de många andra Hollywood-stjarnorna som var med i hans filmer.

programme.title: Tusen timmar
programme.desc: Svensk-danska filmen Tusen timmar handlar om Anna. Hon lever på drommar och soker karleken och sig sjalv. Hon har ett band med Thomas och de ar bara vanner, brukar de saga.

programme.title: Klanen - berattelsen om Grudornas slakt
programme.desc: "Klanen" ar historien om en brottslig slakt dar Mika Kaurismaki behandlar existensens villkor genom den traditionella episka formen, på gransen mellan ratt och fel i lagen. Alexander, den yngsta sonen, ar slaktens vita får. Han forvantas hålla sig på den raka vagen, till skillnad från sin far och andra man i slakten. Men familjen ar varst, och blod ar tjockare an vatten... Familjedramat "Klanen" ar en storslagen hyllning till den gamla finska filmen.

programme.title: Mannen utan minne
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis film om en man som tappar sitt minne och får hjalp av fattiga men storhjartade manniskor i en containerby.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Filmen foljer en doktor som tillhor en grupp på fem overklassherrar som traffas varje månad i ett slutet rum på en lyxkrog. En av dem tar med sig en hemlig ingrediens som kocken tillagar och som de ovriga sedan ska forsoka identifiera. I potten ligger en summa pengar. Doktorns privata problem kommer ifatt honom och leder honom att anvanda sig av en chockerande ingrediens for att overlista de andra.

programme.title: Leningrad Cowboys go America
programme.desc: En film om varldens samsta rockband på en resa från hemknutarna i Sibirien till USA.

programme.title: En tomtesaga
programme.desc: I Lappland for hundra år sedan forlorade lille Nikolas sin familj i en olycka. Byns invånare tog gemensamt hand om pojken. Varje jul flyttade han till en ny familj och for att visa sin tacksamhet gav Nikolas en gång per år presenter till familjernas barn. Men nar Nikolas fyllde 13 år tvingades han borja jobba hos Isak, en bitter snickare som forbjod honom att gora presenter...

programme.title: Tatjana
programme.desc: Valto och Reino ger sig av på bilfard och langs vagen plockar de upp Tatjana och Klaudia. Resan går genom ett Finland som inte påverkats av Nokia eller EU utan forblivit urfinskt. Sin vana trogen levererar Kaurismaki en film utan onodig dialog. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Ljus i skymningen (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis film om nattvakten Koistinen som forlorar jobbet, friheten och drommarna. Men till sist skonjer han en strimma hopp.

programme.title: Munsters Fall
programme.desc: En formogen vinimportor hittas brutalt mordad med ett kraftigt slag mot huvudet. Munster får fallet på sitt bord. Den huvudmisstankte ar offrets fore detta kompanjon. Munster, som till en borjan anser fallet solklart borjar emellertid tvivla. Genom att gå emot en utredning som redan ar klar riskerar han sitt eget liv.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserade Matti (Matti Pellonpaa), som bor under broarna, ar på vag att arva en betydande summa pengar från sin amerikanska faster. Men mannen måste vara representativ under fasterns besok. Matti berattar om situationen for sin van som arbetar som bilhandlare, och denne foreslår en rollbyten mot ersattning.

programme.title: Låt de doda vila
programme.desc: Jimmy ar inte bara en fan av heavy metal, skrack, och det ockulta. Han har ett mål: han vill kontakta sin avlidna mamma. Den nya killen i klassen, charmoren Amir, lockar Jimmy till att imponera skolans två snyggaste tjejer, Louise och Anna, med en liten rit. Efter riten inser Jimmy, att han har begått ett forfardligt misstag, som kan grava fram doda hemligheter och betyda hela jordens undergång.

programme.title: Fallet G
programme.desc: Van Veeterens enda olosta fall kommer upp till ytan igen nar dottern till en privatdetektiv kommer och besoker honom. En våldsam hustrumordare som forsvann under jord for flera år sedan verkar nu ha dykt upp med nytt namn och ar inblandad i ett nytt mord. Van Veeteren har såval professionella som personliga skal att satta fast honom.

programme.title: Hamlet i affarsvarlden
programme.desc: Efter sin faders dod arver Hamlet en styrelseplats i ett gummiforetag. Hamlets farbror kontrollerar foretaget och bestammer sig for att de ska satsa på en ny marknad, namligen gummiankor. Men den nyblivne styrelsemedlemmen ar misstanksam, framforallt over omstandigheterna kring faderns dod. Aki Kaurismaki regisserar har en smått bisarr ”film-noir” variant av Shakespeares HAMLET. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Forskarstudenten Julia och programmeraren Rebecca ingår i ett elitteam vid Lunds universitet. De jobbar med den kontroversiella vetenskapliga metoden biohacking, genteknikens nya hopp som kan betyda slutet for dodliga sjukdomar i vår livstid.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Lognaren
programme.desc: Lognaren ar en beskrivning av en ung skojare som aldrig talar sanning. Den unge mannen spelad av Aki Kaurismaki vandrar genom Helsingfors gator och forsoker låna pengar från bekanta och framlingar med olika forevandningar. Lognaren ar Mika Kaurismakis debutfilm och hans examensarbete från Munchens filmskola.

programme.title: De arvlosa
programme.desc: Mika Kaurismaens forsta långfilm. Han skrev manuset tillsammans med sin bror Aki. "De arvlosa" ar en tidlos skildring av hur småskurken Manne, bonddrangen Harri och den vackra Veera kor en Volga genom de forsvinnande finlandska landskapen, med poliser och gangsters standigt på halarna. Den fartfyllda resan ackompanjeras av tidlosa låtar av bland annat Juice och Rauli Badding.

programme.title: Tatjana
programme.desc: Valto och Reino ger sig av på bilfard och langs vagen plockar de upp Tatjana och Klaudia. Resan går genom ett Finland som inte påverkats av Nokia eller EU utan forblivit urfinskt. Sin vana trogen levererar Kaurismaki en film utan onodig dialog. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Amazon
programme.desc: Den finske mannen Kari (Kari Vaananen) bestemmer seg for å flytte til Brasil med sine to døtre etter kona hans dør. Snart møter han den eventyrlystne amerikanske flygeren Dan (Robert Davi: Die Hard), som forteller Kari om planen sin om å grave etter gull i Amazonas-jungelen. Men Kari møter også den vakre Paola (Rae Dawn Chong: Commando), som lærer ham mer om situasjonen i Amazonas og truslene mot den.

programme.title: Skuggor i paradiset
programme.desc: Nikander ar en ensam sopbils-chauffor som en dag moter den anspråkslosa snabbkopskassorskan Ilona. Nikander blir blixtrande kar, men deras omsesidiga blyghet medfor att det romantiska lyser med sin frånvaro. Så plotsligt andras livet… Ilona får sparken och de bestammer sig for att traffas på ett mysigt litet motell. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Bitchkram
programme.desc: Kristin raknar dagarna till studenten då hon antligen får lamna småstaden och sin manipulativa syster for sina drommars New York. Allt ar perfekt och lokaltidningen på orten har lovat att publicera Kristins kronikor om staden som aldrig sover. Men Kristin missar planet och gommer sig istallet hemma hos Andrea, en marklig ung tjej, långt ute på landet for att undvika total fornedring. I huset ingenstans tar Kristin med Andrea till New Yorks pulserande hjarta i ett vindlande virtuellt aventyr som alla darhemma kan folja i hennes artiklar. Men så tranger sig verkligheten på.

programme.title: Juha
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis stumfilm efter Juhani Ahos triangeldrama hedrar oskuldens år i filmhistorien. Uttryckskraften i de svartvita bilderna stods av Anssi Tikanmakis musik.

programme.title: Svalan, Katten, Rosen, Doden
programme.desc: Munster upptacker kroppen av en ung strypt kvinna i hennes hem och overraskar mordaren som fortfarande finns i lokalen. Mordaren hinner fly men lamnar efter sig en sallsynt bok på platsen. Boken innehåller en halsning från den skyldige. Nar ett offer till hittas satts Van Veeterens litterara kunskaper på prov for att hinna stoppa seriemordaren innan fler mord begås.

programme.title: Helsinki-Napoli All Night Long
programme.desc: Den finske Alex kor taxi på de kalla gatorna i Berlin. Kvallen verkar borja som vilken annan som helst, skjutsa sin fru till jobbet, ta hand om saker med Igor, men sedan hoppar två mystiska man med en stor pengavaska in i bilen, forfoljda av forfoljare! Snart ar skurkarna doda och Alex har i uppdrag att gora sig av med liken.

programme.title: Brott och straff
programme.desc: En filmatisering av Dostojevskijs roman med samma namn, som utspelar sig i 1980-talets Finland. Romanen Brott och straff ar ansedd som en av vår tids storsta litterara verk. Fjodor Dostojevskij målar upp det moraliska dilemmat huruvida ett brott, i det har fallet ett mord ar forsvarbart om resultatet blir positivt for många, om andamålet helgar medlen. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Hamlet i affarsvarlden
programme.desc: Efter sin faders dod arver Hamlet en styrelseplats i ett gummiforetag. Hamlets farbror kontrollerar foretaget och bestammer sig for att de ska satsa på en ny marknad, namligen gummiankor. Men den nyblivne styrelsemedlemmen ar misstanksam, framforallt over omstandigheterna kring faderns dod. Aki Kaurismaki regisserar har en smått bisarr ”film-noir” variant av Shakespeares HAMLET. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Papperstjarnan
programme.desc: "Pappersstjarnan" ar baserad på verkliga handelser. Det handlar om en fotomodell, hennes tre man, ett dekadent liv, utnyttjande och offentlig kritik. Anna (Pirkko Hamalainen) ar en fore detta miss, nu en toppmodell, vars liv spårar ur på grund av mannen. Anna blir så småningom foremål for utnyttjande av både den skumma affarsmannen Ulf (Hannu Lauri) och den alkoholiserade och våldsamma fotografen Ilja (Kari Vaananen). Den enda riktiga vannen visar sig vara Taukka (Matti Rasila), som har en modig installning till livet. Anna beslutar sig for att forsoka fly från de svåra delarna av sitt liv, men det kraver modiga beslut och beredskap att betala deras pris.

programme.title: The Last Border
programme.desc: På en genomgripande fororenad planet återstår endast några få beboeliga zoner. Vid polcirkeln finns en ren region, vars invånare kampar for overlevnad mot en militarjunta och laglosa gerillagang. Livet har forvandlats till en kamp, och faror lurar overallt. Men den farligaste av mannen ar den som redan har forlorat allt.

programme.title: Sverige Er Fantastisk
programme.desc: Efter att ha skadat sin chef flyr de två stripparna, Netty och Mona, från Danmark till Sverige. De hamnar hos en forlamad fore detta punkmusiker och hans bror som ar prast. Under hela deras vistelse utspelar sig ett drama, då romantiska kanslor uppstår mellan de fyra.

programme.title: A Slipping Down Life
programme.desc: Evie Decker ar en ung tillbakadragen kvinna som livnar sig genom att upptrada som kanin på den lokala nojesparken. Allt andras nar hon hor en intervju på radion med sångaren och låtskrivaren i rockbandet Drumstrings Casey. Hon foralskar sig handlost och borjar folja honom runt nar han spelar. Deras olika varldar mots, och frågan ar om de kan lyckas med att kombinera sina liv till en gemensam framtid.

programme.title: Love Hurts
programme.desc: Pauls kvinnoaffarer ersatts med flera komiska incidenter nar han måste tillbringa en helg med sina foraldrar, sin fore detta fru och barnen.

programme.title: If Only
programme.desc: En tragedi lar den unge engelska affarsmannen Ian Wyndham att satta karlek fore arbetet. Han lar sig antligen att oppna sig for sin sjalvstandiga flickvan Samantha Andrews.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.desc: Haley Foster flyttade från sin barndoms småstad Pineridge till storstadslivet i Los Angeles dar hon etablerat sig som hyllad brollopsplanerare på ett prestigefullt foretag som drivs av ms Reynolds.

programme.title: My Best Friends Girl
programme.desc: Tank (Dane Cook) moter det ultimata vanskapsprovet nar hans basta van (Jason Biggs) ber honom att ta ut hans ex (Kate Hudson) på en usel dejt for att hon ska forstå vilken bra pojkvan han ar.

programme.title: The Way You Look Tonight
programme.desc: Peter narmar sig 30 och ar fortfarande vilsen svulsten efter karlek med andlosa online dater utan resultat. En nyckfull date lamnar honom ensam i sangen en morgon nar han vaknar. Peter forsoker lamna allt bakom sig och fortsatter med nya dater från samma site. For varje date oppnas en helt ny varld av upplevelser och erfarenheter som får honom att ifrågasatta allt med naturkrafter, attraktion och akta karlek. Den stora frågan forblir obesvarad, kan Peter verkligen bli foralskad och hitta den akta karleken?

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino ar den misslyckade forfattaren som blev diskare som blev beromd for alla sina fel och brister genom bloggen “Varfor du suger”, den enorma natsuccen som skrivs av hans exfru. Leo traffar sen Colette, sin dromtjej … samma dag som hon gifter sig med den perfekte mannen. Det blir borjan på den ultimata underdog-historien nar den oradde drommaren Leo riskerar allt for att visa Colette och hela varlden allt som ar ratt med en man som ar kand for att inte ha ett enda ratt.

programme.title: My Week With Marilyn
programme.desc: I ett desperat forsok att bli tagen på storre allvar reser ikonen Marilyn Monroe (Michelle Williams) till London 1956 for att spela mot legenden Laurence Olivier i “Prinsen och balettflickan”. Den omhetstorstande Marilyn kanner sig overgiven av maken Arthur Miller och attraherad av Oliviers assistent, den unge Colin Clark. Colin blir snart Marilyns fasta och trygga punkt, samtidigt som han också blir Oliviers endahopp att kunna slutfora sin film genom sin formåga att hålla den impulsiva Marilyn i schakt. Upp over oronen foralskadar det nu Colins hjarta som riskerar att krossas av varldens storsta och vackraste filmstjarna!

programme.title: Leading Lady
programme.desc: Denna romantiska komedi berattar historien om den lovande brittiska skådespelerskan Jodi Rutherford, som overtalar Kobus Willemse, en bonde från Brandfort, om att hjalpa henne med rollen som krigshjaltinna i en storbudgetfilm. I gentjanst arrangerar Jodi den årliga konserten på Willemses gård. Jodis upplevelser i Brandfort lar henne att det finns mer i livet an Hollywoods filmvarld... eller gor det det?

programme.title: Burning Man
programme.desc: Tom ar chefskock på en chic restaurant på Bondi beach i Sydney. Han ar en arrogant typ som ser flyktigt på tillvaron. Han beter sig sjalviskt och allmant illa mot sina kollegor och sin 8-årige son Oscar, men aven mot de många kvinnorna i hans liv, exfrun Karen, kollegan Sally, psykologen Miriam, Lisa som ar lyckligt gift, prostituerade Lesley och maklaren Carol som skulle salja hans hus. Men Tom har inte alltid varit osympatisk. For tio år sedan traffade han vackra, perfekta Sarah. Hon tog fram det basta hos Tom och gav honom deras gemensamma son.

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: I denna stormiga komedi av Woody Allen, upptacker två par att graset inte alltid ar gronare på andra sidan. Alfie Shepridge (ANTHONY HOPKINS) dumpar sin fru sedan 40 år (GEMMA JONES), i ett forsok att återuppleva ungdomens nojen tillsammans med en ung callgirl (LUCY PUNCH). For att få ratsida på sitt liv tar den forsmådda hustrun hjalp av en spådam. Samtidigt blir deras dotter Sally (NAOMI WATTS) foralskad i sin chef (ANTONIO BANDERAS), och hennes make (JOSH BROLIN) blir besatt av skonheten som bor på andra sidan gatan (FREIDA PINTO). Och snart hanger både deras forhållanden och deras forstånd i samma skora tråd...

programme.title: Granada Nights
programme.desc: En brittisk turist ar fast i Granada, Spanien, med ett brustet hjarta. Han kanner sig vilse och overgiven, blir van med en grupp utlandska studenter och kastar sig in i utbytesstudenternas varld. Han tar sig utanfor sin egen bekvamlighetszon och forsoker få en nystart i livet, men bakom varje horn lurar en påminnelse om hans fore detta flickvan, och han kampar for att hitta ett avslut. Ett karleksbrev till Granada som blandar dokumentar med fiktion for att skapa en verklig och akta skildring av hur det går till att upptacka sig sjalv. Filmad i ett unikt bildforhållande som aldrig tidigare visats på bio.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Nar Joel (Paul Rudd) och Molly (Amy Poehler) mottes var det hat vid forsta ogonkastet: hans storbolag Godiskompaniet hotade att stanga ner hennes bohemiska godisaffar. Plus att Joel fortfarande hade kanslor for sitt sexiga ex (Cobie Smulders). Men, trots allt så blir de kara, tills dess att de gor slut och Molly borjar dejta sin revisor (Ed Helms). Men, precis i sluttampen...tja, du får se helt enkelt. (Ledtråd: Joel håller ett stort tal och de hittar tillbaka till varandra.) Från regissoren som skapade Wet Hot American Summer, Wanderlust och Role Models kommer nu en helknapp och satirisk underminering av den romantiska komedigenren.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Sistaårseleverna Michael och Matty har varit basta kompisar sen lågstadiet. Då de fortfarande ar oskulder sluter de en pakt att hjalpa varandra att få i sang någon innan studentbalen, men deras planer andras drastiskt nar Matt berattar att han ar homosexuell.

programme.title: Dubbelt begar
programme.desc: Dubbelt begar berattar historien om den unga kvinnan Chloe, som benagen till depression påborjar terapi och dar blir foralskad i sin psykoterapeut Paul. Efter ett par månader flyttar hon in hos sin nya alskare men upptacker snabbt att han doljer en del av sin identitet for henne.

Var och en bar på drommar, for vilka de ar beredda att satsa allt på detta sista hjaltedåd – om de bara kunde komma ihåg vad de skulle gora.

programme.desc: Nar en asteroid narmar sig jorden blir en man (Steve Carell) ensam efter att hans hustru lamnat honom i panik. Han bestammer sig for att ta en "road trip" for att återforenas med sin high school sweetheart. Grannen (Keira Knightley) foljer med honom for att oavsiktligt satta kappar i hjulet for hans plan.

programme.title: Karlekens sloja (The Painted Veil)
programme.desc: Kitty ar en rastlos ung kvinna från overklassen som vill bort från sin familj. Nar hon traffar lakaren Walter Fane ser hon sin chans och gifter sig med honom. Tillsammans flyttar de till Shanghai dar Kitty blir foralskad i en annan man.

programme.title: Le week-end
programme.desc: Humoristiskt relationsdrama om Nick och Meg Burrows som återvander till Paris, staden dar de en gång tillbringade sin smekmånad, for att fira sin 30:e brollopsdag. Under en helg tankt att återuppvacka lite romantik i det långlivade aktenskapet får vi folja paret nar relationen stalls på sin spets, och gral, karlek och passion varvas på ett humoristiskt och smartsamt satt.

programme.title: Loves Last Resort
programme.desc: Efter att ha dejtat i tio år har Chloes pojkvan Eric annu ite mognat till den man hon onskar han skulle vara. Hon hoppas skynda på forloppet genom att dumpa honom. Sex månader senare traffas de och Eric avslojar nyheten om att han ska gifta sig. For att komma bort tar hon semester och på samma semesterort dyker Eric med flickvan upp.

programme.title: Leading Lady
programme.desc: Denna romantiska komedi berattar historien om den lovande brittiska skådespelerskan Jodi Rutherford, som overtalar Kobus Willemse, en bonde från Brandfort, om att hjalpa henne med rollen som krigshjaltinna i en storbudgetfilm. I gentjanst arrangerar Jodi den årliga konserten på Willemses gård. Jodis upplevelser i Brandfort lar henne att det finns mer i livet an Hollywoods filmvarld... eller gor det det?

programme.title: 9 1/2 vecka (9½ Weeks)
programme.desc: En erotisk historia om en kvinna som jobbar på ett konstgalleri och som lockas in i ett opersonligt intimt forhållande med en man. Hon vet nastan inget om mannens liv, det enda hon ser ar deras sexlekar och deras relation blir alltmer komplicerad. Erotisk kultfilm med Oscarsvinnaren Kim Basinger och Oscarsnominerade Mickey Rourke

programme.title: You Get Me
programme.desc: Tyler ar vansinnigt kar i sin perfekta flickvan Ali. Nar han efter ett praktgral gor slut med Ali hamnar han i famnen på sexiga Holly. Hon ar ny i stan och ger honom en natt som han aldrig kommer att glomma. Morgonen darpå får Tyler veta att Ali vill ha tillbaka honom och att Holly ska borja på deras skola och hon ar fast besluten att gora Tyler till sin.

programme.title: Albert Nobbs
programme.desc: Albert ar en forsynt man som doljer en stor hemlighet, han ar egentligen en kvinna som tvingats kla och bete sig som en man for att komma bort från fattigdom. En dag moter Albert en annan manniska i samma situation och han borjar dromma om ett liv i frihet utan hemligheter. Albert Nobbs ar en stark och rorande film med en stjarnspackad rollista.

programme.title: En Midsommarnatts Drom (William Shakespeares A Midsummer Nights Dream)
programme.desc: Blandande vacker Shakespeare-filmatisering om alskande par på villovagar i en fortrollad skog. Kevin Kline blir forvandlad till åsna av Michelle Pfeiffers alvdrottning.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E09 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 9, Great Britain
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E10 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 10, Poland Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E11 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 11, Poland Part 2
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E12 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 12, Bosnia
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E13 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 13, Romania
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E14 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 14, Gibraltar
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E15 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 15, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E16 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 16, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E01 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 1 - Finland
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E02 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 2 - Serbia
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E03 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E04 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E05 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E06 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - Worlds Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E07 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E08 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E09 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E10 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - Worlds Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official Worlds Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what Im going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E14 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E15 Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E16 Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.
